lines.5: 「And that settles it. What a commotion.」
lines.6: 「Is that really how you see me?! Sure, I play dating sims, but I play shooters and stuff too!」
lines.11: 「Aw, I'm so glad, Leo. I was so worried that I folded a thousand paper cranes in my heart.」
lines.12: 「You give me back my ten thousand yen.」
lines.14: 「I see. So that is what happened this morning.」
lines.15: 「In any case, Princess... You have several problems that need correcting. It is time I used my legs.」
lines.17: 「It is not an attack. Call it instruction!」
lines.20: 「Oh? You have improved, Princess. That is more like it.」
lines.21: They lock together in a straining contest of strength.
lines.22: 「I've been training every day too... You won't keep pushing me around forever.」
lines.23: 「But you cannot defeat me in strength. I am not even using one tenth of my power.」
lines.24: 「Well, I am actually only using about one twelfth of mine.」
lines.27: 「What are you spacing out for, Leo?」
